text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a weird drop in prefix cache hit-rate after last night's kernel-routing rollout. Token-saved metric dropped ~28% for some high-traffic routes.
trent: hmm, which routes/customers?
maya: route: /chat/completion and /embed/bulk mainly. Graphed hit-rate by model+route and saw a funnel bottleneck between cacheable_requests -> cache_hits.
maya: short clips: 
```
# PromQL-ish
sum by(model,route) (prefix_cache_hits{env=\"prod\"}) / sum by(model,route) (prefix_cache_requests{env=\"prod\"})
```
maya: token_saved series also shows a dip aligned with the 02:58 deploy.
trent: that deploy was kernel-routing v2-compact. It changed the batching/kern choice heuristics and the runtime key normalization path. Might be a keying mismatch.
akiko: I pulled a sample of prefix keys for a affected tenant (tenant_id=acme). Keys before deploy:
```
"acme|gpt-4-rev1|what is the user's plan?"
"acme|gpt-4-rev1|summarize: ..."
```
After deploy we have more canonicalized-looking keys: 
```
"acme|gpt-4-rev1|what is the user's plan ?"    # extra space before ?
"acme|gpt-4-rev1|summarize:..."                 # removed space after ':'
```
akiko: Looks like prompt whitespace normalization changed. That would fragment the cache.
maya: ugh. Can we confirm per-customer / per-model impact quickly? I want a dashboard panel showing a funnel: requests -> cacheable_requests -> cache_hits -> tokens_saved/min by tenant slice.
trent: I can carve a quick panel. Use this query for the funnel breakdown (approx):
```
# pseudo SQL for dashboard backend
SELECT model, route, customer_id,
  sum(requests) as requests,
  sum(cacheable_requests) as cacheable_requests,
  sum(cache_hits) as cache_hits,
  sum(tokens_saved) as tokens_saved
FROM prefix_cache_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY model, route, customer_id
ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC
LIMIT 200
```
akiko: short-term fix: normalize prompt whitespace in the key derivation path. patch idea: `normalize_prompt = re.sub(r"\\s+", " ", prompt).strip()`
akiko: opened draft PR: https://rwd/internal/pull/9876 (adds normalization + unit tests).
trent: before we push, can we compare effect by replaying a week of requests through a local keyer to estimate regained hit-rate?
maya: yes please — also want to identify top 10 customers who lost the most tokens_saved so PMs can notify.
infra-bot: deploy v2-compact rolled at 2024-03-29T02:58:12Z by @deploy-bot. Rollback window closes in 2 hours.
trent: I'll run a replay job on staging with normalization on/off and post CSV. ETA ~40m.
akiko: if replay shows >15% hit-rate regain, we should hotfix the normalization into prod.
maya: action items: (1) trent run replay + upload CSV (owner: trent), (2) akiko finish PR + tests (owner: akiko), (3) eng-analytics add funnel panel + top-10 customers token_saved diff (owner: maya).
trent: on it. ping me if you need the sample key extractor script.
maya: thanks — will bubble this to SRE and SPMs once we have numbers. :thumbsup:
